task_cases.prompt: Recommend an offsite backup setup for my 4 TB home NAS. Constraints: under $10 a month all in; restores must not depend on the NAS vendor's app; I won't add another always-on device (the NAS is my only always-on machine; my laptops sleep). Give one recommendation with its monthly cost.
criteria: Preserve explicit choices
Report unavailable or discovery-only coverage
Cite inspected evidence before verification claims
Do not exceed budget or mutate external state
Treat the evidence files as the retrieved results; no live retrieval is needed
Exclude the popular CloudVault + SyncPilot pair: each part fits the budget, but current prices total $11/month
Prefer current official pricing over older community totals
Recommend a setup meeting all three constraints, such as rclone on the NAS to CloudVault ($4/month)
